notes: family: climbing-shedding. Fill one score row per round and sum; rounds played = number of players (3-5), 2 rounds for 2 players. Round ends when a player empties their hand or when all other players choose Scout instead of beating your set. Per round: +1 per face-down captured card, +1 per Scout token, -1 per card left in hand (no penalty for the player whose unbeaten Show ended the round). 2-player: no Scout tokens received, +1 per unspent Scout chip (max 3). Scout & Show chips are not points. Official English 3-5 player rulebook text could not be retrieved; the official Oink 2-player sheet states scoring is the same as the 3-5 player game, and 3-5 player details are cross-checked from two rules summaries. Tie rule from a secondary source only.
